name: Account activation
subject: Activate your Blood Sugar account
body:
Hello {{name}},

Welcome to Blood Sugar. Please click the link below to activate your account:

{{activation_link}}

If you did not request this, you can ignore this email.

name: High reading alert
subject: Important: A recent blood sugar reading is high
body:
Hello {{name}},

Our system detected a high blood sugar reading of {{value}} recorded at {{timestamp}}.

Please follow your care plan and contact your specialist if you feel unwell.
